title: Orchestration of conditional behavior rollouts and replay harness for streaming/tool-calls
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: provide a safe, observable, and automatable way to roll out conditional behavior changes (behavior flags) that affect streaming responses, function/tool calling, and structured-output schemas. This ticket covers the orchestration layer for staged gates, a replay harness to run realistic historical traffic against candidate flag states, and tooling to summarize behavioral deltas for PM/QA. Scope includes: flag orchestration API, a replay-runner that consumes request traces and KV cache patterns, regression detection rules, and a UI summary export for Console. Out of scope: new runtime kernels or quantization changes (those are separate), and long-term metric storage (we'll emit to existing dashboards).
acceptance_criteria: Flag orchestration API supports: feature unit (on/off/percentage), region scoping, model-variant mapping, and scheduled rollout windows
Replay harness can re-run 24h of sampled production requests (including streaming chunks and toolcall sequences) against N flag permutations and produce a diff report
Regression detector flags a behavioral regression if normalized semantic difference > threshold or if structured-output schema mismatches occur
Rollout UI/CLI can start/stop a staged rollout and surface top-10 request traces that changed behavior
Automated tests added: unit tests for orchestration logic, integration tests against a local replay fixture, and an e2e job in CI that runs a small replay against the latest runtime image
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Build orchestration API and small internal CLI (dev-only) - internal smoke tests
Phase 1: Wire replay harness to internal trace store, run 48h backfill for two recent releases
Phase 2: Expose UI in Console behind 'flag-rollout' permission and guard with SSO, soft-launch to Platform team
Phase 3: Gradual production rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on regression signals
Phase 4: Post-rollout retrospective and exportable incident notes
test_plan: Unit: decision logic, percentage sampling, region scoping, and scheduling rules
Integration: replay harness against a deterministic fixture that includes streaming chunk interleaving and two-step toolcalls
Regression detection: synthetic diffs to verify detector thresholds and schema mismatch alerts
Load: run replay harness with 100k small requests to verify runtime memory and KV cache behavior under replay
Canary: small live canary with platform-team traffic and human verification checklist
updates: 2025-02-15 Asha: initial RFC drafted; included replay requirements and high-level detector heuristics
2025-02-20 Liam: prototyped replay fixture and verified we can rehydrate KV cache for 10k sequences locally
2025-02-26 QA: suggested adding schema-aware comparators to reduce noise from benign lexical changes
2025-03-03 Asha: locked acceptance criteria; security sign-off requested for UI exposure
comments: PM review (Elena Romero): please ensure the replay harness records token-level latency deltas for cost modeling
Design review (Marco Li): propose a compact UI table for top diffs with side-by-side streaming transcripts
Infra (Nora Singh): will provide ephemeral S3 buckets for replay artifacts; need retention policy defined
risks_mitigation: Risk: high noise in diffs leads to false positives. Mitigation: multi-stage detector (semantic + schema) and manual review gate before rollback
Risk: replay may not reproduce live KV cache priming. Mitigation: capture cache keys in traces and allow 'warmup' replay step
Risk: exposing UI prematurely. Mitigation: feature guarded by SSO group and audit log of all rollouts
notes: Design trade-off: percentage-based rollouts are easier but may miss regional skew; include region scoping to address this
We will reuse existing cost dashboards for token deltas rather than invent a new metric store
This work is intentionally modular to allow using the orchestration layer for other feature gates in the future
